shared_elements: stacked decoration over a vertical surface
justification: Both surfaces show schematic relief designs made up of stylized zoomorphic/profile forms and repeated sign-like motifs arranged vertically, with the closest correspondence being the use of stacked animal-like and curving forms rather than a single naturalistic scene. The biggest difference is that A has clearer separated registers, recognizable bird/quadruped-like figures and geometric bands, while B is a dense interlocking field of abstract glyphic/serpentine forms with no matching specific figures or relationships.
